nonzero_target_law: uniform scalar k in {1,...,42}; public point kQ on the fixed order-43 group
endpoint_law: for n=1..M and multipliers c in {1,2,6}, include both c*n and -c*n modulo 43
generic_bound: for an arbitrary finite endpoint map from Fin M x Fin C x Bool into target points, at most 2*M*C distinct targets are covered; for uniform N-element targets, hit probability is at most min(1,2*M*C/N)
